meta.title: CostOps Hub
meta.description: Opens a cross-session bill page from the CostOps Hub entry in the sidebar: tokens priced at official list prices, split into money saved on local routes and money spent on cloud routes (last hour / today / 7 / 30 days and this session), with per-model session drill-down and CSV export; the composer pill shows the current session. The ledger only reads local session logs and sends nothing; power and hardware are not counted.
